name: key
title: CCS-compatible provider domain rebuild
description: Planning package for a complete CLI-Manager-owned provider domain: full configuration editors, type common config, manual multi-key, global Home switching, native project/Worktree resolution, Home diagnostics, and CCS import.
creator: hxx
notes: Planning and prototype are complete. As of 2026-08-03, Phase 0 is implemented: providers.db path/opener/schema, WAL and backup boundary, composite identity, manual-key constraints, and fixture tests. Phase 1 catalog/key work is implemented and reviewed: native catalog/key repository and Tauri commands, secret-redacted DTOs, key projection/invariants, atomic active-key replacement, type-local common JSON/TOML editor with inheritance preview, and a localized Settings -> Native Providers catalog/editor with split-responsibility components. Complete Claude/Codex/Grok document editors are implemented: Claude settings.json, Codex auth.json/config.toml, and Grok Build config.toml, including backend validation, TOML parsing, redaction, managed-secret preservation, and unsaved-draft isolation. Validation passed: cargo test --no-fail-fast (808 passed, 1 ignored), cargo check, and npx tsc --noEmit. The legacy CCS read-only page remains isolated as an import source. Remaining work is Phase 2 Home resolver/diagnostics/global apply, Phase 3 native project/Worktree resolution and terminal cutover, Phase 4 CCS import/repair, Phase 5 Home/environment/import UI plus source/effective/live-diff and accessibility hardening, and Phase 6 cutover regression/cleanup. Keep this task in_progress; do not archive until the acceptance gates are met.
